To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the enterprise architecture framework TOGAF is the de facto standard, but that the essential layers and artifacts of enterprise architecture are not yet fully defined.
the essential layers of an enterprise architecture framework are the business architecture layer, the data layer and the application layer.

enterprise architecture is a hierarchical, multilayered, multiviewed, multi-dimensional system with three layers (business, application, technology) that are linked by dependencies and that is composed of four types of artifacts (strategy, capability, information, and solution).
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of what is essential to enterprise architecture.
the question of what constitutes the essence of enterprise architectures and what are essential elements of enterprise architectures.
the following research questions: Which architecture layers are relevant for the architecture of a company?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

enterprise architecture comprises at least the following essential elements: (1) a hierarchical, multilayer architecture model, (2) a business architecture, (3) a data architecture, (4) an application architecture, (5) a technology architecture, (6) a business process architecture, (7) an architecture governance model, (8) an architecture roadmap, (9) a set of enterprise architecture views, and (10) an architecture management process.

enterprise architecture consists of the following layers: (1) business strategy, (2) business architecture, (3) application architecture, (4) technology architecture and (5) infrastructure architecture.
enterprise architecture is not a monolithic, closed system, but a set of interrelated and overlapping artifacts that need to be managed in an iterative and incremental way.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

there are no clear and widely accepted definitions of enterprise architecture layers, artifact types, and dependencies, but that a common understanding can be derived by looking at the existing literature and by analyzing the practice of enterprise architecture in large enterprises.
enterprise architecture is a hierarchical, multilayer model that consists of several artifacts and is related to other architecture models.
the most important elements of enterprise architecture are the architecture layers business architecture, data architecture, application architecture and technology architecture.
The main takeaway from our work is that

enterprise architecture is a complex system with many dependencies and interfaces to other architecture types, and that the current enterprise architecture frameworks do not sufficiently address these aspects.
there is no one-size-fits-all solution for enterprise architecture, but that there are several essential elements that should be considered in any enterprise architecture approach.
enterprise architecture is not a single, static model, but a set of related models that can be used to address different questions at different points in time.
